name: Monster is Me
detailed_description:
Calling all monsters!


Prove yourself in "Monster is Me," a rogue-like where you become the architect of destruction in ever-changing, procedurally generated cities. No two cities are the same, but every city is fully destructible! Dive into urban landscapes, teeming with skyscrapers, landmarks, and unsuspecting citizens. From collapsing banks to explosive gas stations, every structure is a potential tool in your path of destruction.

1-4 PLAYER COMPETITIVE CO-OP


Conquer solo or team up with fellow monsters in a race to wreak havoc and establish yourself as the ultimate force of mayhem! Coordinate attacks, strategize, and combine your monstrous powers to lay waste to all humanity. But don't help the other monsters too much, you are each independently scored on your performance. The better your personal score, the stronger you become. Prove once and for all that you are the better monster by scoring higher than anyone on your team!

ESCALATING DYNAMIC MISSIONS


Every play-through, dozens of unique cities await your arrival. Rampage with purpose through each city as you seek to achieve specific missions. These missions include demolishing landmarks, surviving military onslaught, reaching certain destruction levels within a time limit, and more. Each monster is scored independently for each mission. The cities react dynamically to your onslaught with increasing intensity in an attempt to counter your missions. Citizens flee in terror, military scrambles to respond, and massive environmental hazards are unleashed. Will all the monsters survive long enough to achieve all the missions?

LITTLE BIG MONSTERS


Choose from a diverse lineup of gigantic monsters, each with its own special abilities, personal agenda, and tragic backstory. Wield powerful claws, unleash fiery breath, create seismic shock-waves, or charm the humans to do your bidding as you dominate the cityscape. Every monster features 2 unique play styles to choose from when embarking on a new destructive quest. Working on your monster's personal agenda may sidetrack you from achieving the city mission but it will provide boosts to your monster's unique abilities.

MUTATED YOUR WAY


Whether achieving your personal agenda or performing well on city missions, your monster will increase in strength. Each time you increase in strength, you will be presented with rich opportunities to mutate your existing abilities or the option to gain new. These mutations are semi-randomly available but allow you to customize your monster in unique ways each time you play. Mutations will range from enhanced strength to gaining unique traversal options.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY


With rogue-like gameplay, procedurally generated cities, a variety of monsters, manifold mutation types, and unpredictable multiplayer battles, "Monster is Me" offers limitless replayability. Every game is a new opportunity to showcase your destructive prowess.

Are you ready to unleash the monster within and compete for the crown of chaos? The cityscape awaits your monstrous might in "Monster is Me" – where the only rule is there are no rules in the race to be the ultimate giant monster!
